_note: Luo-Rudy phase I (1991) guinea-pig ventricular action-potential model. All values from Luo & Rudy, Circ Res 1991;68:1501-1526 (ref luo_rudy_1991); gating uses the Hodgkin-Huxley x-infinity/tau formalism (hodgkin_huxley_1952), integrated by Rush-Larsen (rush_larsen_1978). Units: V in mV, t in ms, currents in uA/cm^2, conductances in mS/cm^2, concentrations in mM, Cm in uF/cm^2.

Ko.note: Extracellular K+ (fixed); conductances scale with sqrt([K]o/5.4).

Cai0.note: Resting intracellular Ca2+ (0.2 uM); the only dynamic concentration.

G_Na.note: Fast Na+ current max conductance. I_Na = G_Na·m^3·h·j·(V−E_Na).

G_si.note: Slow inward (L-type-like Ca2+) current conductance. E_si = 7.7 − 13.0287·ln([Ca]i).

ca_influx_k.note: Conversion of I_si to Ca2+ uptake: d[Ca]i/dt = −1e-4·I_si + 0.07·(1e-4 − [Ca]i).

G_K.note: Time-dependent (delayed rectifier) K+ conductance at [K]o=5.4; scaled by sqrt([K]o/5.4). I_K = G_K·X·Xi·(V−E_K).

G_K1.note: Time-independent (inward rectifier) K+ conductance at [K]o=5.4; scaled by sqrt([K]o/5.4).

G_Kp.note: Plateau K+ current conductance. I_Kp = G_Kp·Kp·(V−E_K1), Kp = 1/(1+exp((7.488−V)/5.98)).

amplitude.note: Stimulus amplitude (applied as inward, i.e. −80). Above threshold for an all-or-none AP.

bcl.note: Default basic cycle length for periodic pacing (2 Hz).
